verified: Myriota announced on 24 November 2026 that it closed the first tranche of its Series C, raising AU$60 million (about US$40 million), led by Main Sequence Ventures, Hostplus and the National Reconstruction Fund Corporation, with Funds SA joining as a new investor, according to the company's own announcement; Myriota says the money will scale its satellite constellation and fund hiring and expansion, and Dealroom puts its cumulative funding above AU$160 million (US$107.5 million).
unconfirmed: The final size of the round — the company says the first close came ahead of schedule and the round has yet to close, so the total remains unknown; SmartCompany reports a "$50 million raise" with AU$25 million from the NRFC, a figure that conflicts with the AU$60 million first close and that no source reconciles; the WSJ framing of Myriota as helping "bridge the gap between AI and the real world" is the outlet's characterization, and the figure of 100 new jobs rests on a single report.

verified: Myriota 于 2026 年 11 月 24 日发布公司公告（阿德莱德），宣布提前完成 C 轮首次交割，金额为 6000 万澳元（约 4000 万美元），由 Main Sequence Ventures 与澳大利亚国家重建基金（NRFC）领投，Hostplus 亦参与领投；《华尔街日报》记者 Rhiannon Hoyle 报道的“约 4000 万美元”与该公告金额一致。
unconfirmed: 本轮最终总额与估值——公司公告称融资仍在推进、将按计划完成，Dealroom 称其累计融资已超过 1.6 亿澳元（约 1.075 亿美元），但这些均无独立第三方核实；SmartCompany 报道的数额为 5000 万澳元、其中 NRFC 出资 2500 万澳元，与公司公告的 6000 万澳元首关金额不一致，报道未解释差异；“新增 100 个岗位”这一扩张目标仅见于 SmartCompany，公司公告未逐项确认。

titles.en: Myriota raises about $40M in first close of Series C
titles.zh: 澳大利亚卫星物联网公司 Myriota 完成约 4000 万美元 C 轮首关，《华尔街日报》报道
